source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A / Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC catalog and delivery
selection: One actual lowest-scene-cloud seasonal capture per year whose scene bounding box contains the study extent: January-March for Sundarbans; June-September for Rondonia. Dates never exceed retrieval time. Scene cloud cover is not a local cloud mask; SCL assets are supplied for local masking. Per-band reflectance scale and additive offset are read from each actual product XML, with zero additive offset only when the product has no BOA_ADD_OFFSET entry.

selection.localCloudMask: SCL supplied; local quality not inferred from scene cloud percentage
